attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole entry is two sentences, of which the second is the admission that there is no more: «Δεν έχουμε άλλες λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγίου». That is a want of knowledge and not saint.gr's asterisked refusal to vouch for an entry; the page carries no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The one thing it does say of him is that he was a fool for Christ, which is what `types` holds; it gives no century, so there is no `dates` object. No hymn is printed.
